finding: zenodo.org answers a request that carries no User-Agent header with an HTML 403 ("Access to this resource has been restricted due to unusual traffic from your network") before the request reaches the InvenioRDM application. The identical request with a User-Agent header is served normally. The client IP was not blocked: a normal request three seconds earlier and three seconds later both returned 200.
